subject: CODE to ART: PartyMember consumer geometry fields
body: New UI PartyMember accepts geometry {width,height,portraitCircle:[cx,cy,radius],textSafeArea:[x,y,w,h]} and frame URL separately; places original portrait as circular HTML clip, text as separate positioned region with wrapping. Please export ui-kit contract with compatible geometry or publish exact field names for adapter in OrchardExpedition. Your ui-kit owns metadata and URL export. Reviewed correct contextual-button circle+text source. No art writes from code.
